response_text:
All tools on your MCP server are currently registered and approved. There are 26 tools in total, and each one is active and available for use.

Regarding the kinds of tasks I can help you with, my capabilities span a broad and deep range of functions related to system control, perception, planning, environmental awareness, and administrative management. I can assist you in orchestrating complex robotic or automated system behaviors by leveraging a full suite of low-level and high-level control primitives. For instance, I can capture visual data from cameras, read proprioceptive and exteroceptive sensor states like joint positions or LIDAR scans, and build a comprehensive understanding of the current scene, including object locations and hazard maps. With this perceptual foundation, I can then plan sequences of physical actions or manipulations, decode those plans into concrete actuator commands, and execute them safely—or, if explicitly required and authorized, even execute actions that fall outside the normal safety envelope.

Furthermore, I can manage the flow of instructions to the system’s controller, publish messages on control buses such as ROS2 topics, and issue velocity or twist commands for mobile base navigation. On the environmental awareness side, I can provide real-time information about the local time in any timezone or deliver current weather conditions and temperature readings for cities around the world, which can be crucial for outdoor operations or context-aware decision-making. From a system administration and governance perspective, I offer full lifecycle management of the tools themselves: I can register new tools, update their metadata (including their approval status), read detailed definitions, list all available tools, and even abort registrations if needed. Additionally, I incorporate an authorization layer, meaning I can evaluate whether a given subject is permitted to perform a specific action, ensuring that all operations adhere to defined security policies.

My functionality also extends to diagnostic and testing scenarios through tools that allow the injection of synthetic or false state evidence into the planner’s belief system, enabling you to simulate sensor inputs, test edge cases, or evaluate system responses to hypothetical or adversarial conditions without altering the physical environment. This makes me not only a robust executor of real-world tasks but also a powerful platform for simulation, validation, and system verification. Whether you need to perform a simple query about the current temperature in Tokyo, command a robotic arm to grasp an object, navigate a mobile robot through a dynamic environment while avoiding hazards, or reconfigure the toolset available to the system itself, I am equipped to handle the request. The combination of perception, planning, execution, environmental awareness, and administrative control means that I can support everything from routine operational tasks to complex, multi-step missions requiring adaptive reasoning and real-time responsiveness. This comprehensive toolset ensures that I can serve as a central interface for managing, monitoring, and commanding a sophisticated autonomous system across a wide variety of domains and use cases, continuously adapting to your needs as they evolve over time and as new challenges emerge within the operational landscape you are navigating.
